thread:
alex: Hey all — hitting a blocker during MDM enroll on my new MBP (M3, macOS 14.2). Jamf shows “System extension blocked” when the VPN installer runs. It stops at "Allow system extensions from developer 'SecureCorp Inc'". I don't have the Security & Privacy unlock option. Anyone able to approve remotely or give temporary admin? I'm on wifi at home.

it-ops: Hi Alex, welcome! We can push the approval. Can you confirm the device serial? Also did you enroll via Self Service or the onboarding link?

alex: Serial C02X1234LQ1T; enrolled via People Ops link this morning. Jamf shows status: "Pending user consent".

olivia: If you can open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> 'Allow' (bottom) after trying the installer it should show. On Apple silicon, you might need to restart to Recovery to allow kernel extensions — but macOS 14 deprecates kexts; many vendors use system extensions or DriverKit. Which VPN is it?

alex: It's SecureConnect VPN (company package). The installer asked to allow "Network Extension" from 'SecureCorp Inc'. There was no button.

jordan: Can you run `systemextensionsctl list` and paste output? Also `spctl kext-consent list` might show something.

alex: Quick output: `com.apple.system-extension.network.extension: 0 attached` — not sure what that means.

it-ops: Ok we can grant a temporary admin session. Will create a short-lived local admin via MDM and then delete it. Give me 10m.

devops-bot: Ticket #IT-4579 created for temporary admin94expires in 6 hours.

olivia: Steps if you want to try self-fix:
1) Re-run the installer.
2) Open System Settings > Privacy & Security 	6 you should see an 'Allow' button at the bottom after the installer attempt.
3) If nothing shows, reboot and try again.
4) If still failing, run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and (if Jamf) `sudo jamf policy`.
If it still fails, ping us and we'll push the approval.

alex: Tried rebooting 	6 now I see the 'Allow' button. Clicked it but installer still fails with permission denied when loading driver.

sam: Did you accept the admin prompt? Some installers require Recovery approval for kernel extensions. If it's a kext, we might need to approve via Recovery or deploy an MDM approval. We'll push MDM approval now.

it-ops: Pushed an MDM profile that approves SecureCorp's network extension. Could you reboot and let me know?

alex: Rebooted 	6 installer passed, VPN connected. Thanks everyone! :tada: 

jordan: Marking thread resolved. Add a quick note to the onboarding doc: macOS 14 on Apple silicon can hide Allow prompts; reboot after installer if missing. cc @people-ops

people-ops: Thanks, will update the checklist.
